events.outcome: Several self-selected 2026 reviews report numbers already used, service blocking or SMS failures on Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram and Google, while other reviews report eventual code receipt after retrying. Service/country/operator/order details cannot support exact-app success-rate estimates.

A community comparison author reports 5SIM one-time activation inventory as low-cost but inconsistent in 2026, without an exact service/country/operator reproduction or statistical denominator. One author report, not a platform-wide failure rate.

data.caveat: Useful for one-time jobs; do not build account recovery around ordinary activation orders.

data.summary: No physical SIM activation is involved; service/country/operator inventory is dynamic.
data.outsideHomeNote: Physical location is not the same thing as the selected number country. Recheck target-service eligibility before purchase.

data.simType: digital order; no owned SIM or phone line
data.acquisitionSummary: 5SIM is an SMS activation marketplace. One-time activations are selected by service, country and operator; separate hosting/rental products exist but do not imply perpetual access to a real mobile number. Final inventory and price are dynamic.
data.chinaActivation: Online marketplace order, not SIM/eSIM activation. Choosing a number country does not establish physical-location rights, carrier subscriber identity, or dependable mainland-China app receipt.
data.kyc: varies by funding method and order; universal requirements not verified
data.payment: Account funding precedes orders. Buyer-specific payment method, funding floor, screening and withdrawal conditions were not verified.
data.wifiCalling: not applicable: no owned voice line
data.roamingSms: not applicable: the purchased SMS inbox is not a roaming phone-number line
data.refund: Provider says no-SMS timed-out activations normally return cost to marketplace balance; completed orders with SMS are not refundable. Used or 2FA-protected number disputes require evidence/screenshots or video; support FAQ says API-purchased numbers are ineligible for its used-number refund route. No unconditional cash-back promise.
data.holdReason: Temporary one-time marketplace product, not a long-term mobile-number route. Current prices vary by service/country/operator, and independent 2026 reports describe failed codes/reused or blocked numbers. No reproducible exact-app sample or verified success rate. HOLD, not a recommended durable route.
data.tariffSummary: Dynamic one-time SMS activation price by service/country/operator; hosting/rental separate. No durable ownership, retention interval or annual keep fee.
guideSteps: Check the selected service, country and operator in the live marketplace before funding a number order.
Treat an ordinary activation as temporary message receipt, not a physical SIM, owned mobile number or recoverable long-term identity.
Confirm current order expiry and refund eligibility; completed SMS orders and used-number disputes have different treatment.
Do not equate separate hosting/rental options with a durable account-recovery line.
Keep important accounts on a durable number rather than an ordinary temporary activation.
